purpose: Teach: 下北沢/築地/吉祥寺/バルサ/ヘッジファンド/スピリチュアル/おっぱい/ハイビジョン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが下北沢の本屋さんに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to that bookstore in Shimokita.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Sharing news gently with a child. Slight rise at the end—gentle excitement for him. Unhurried, like she's already picturing his face when he hears.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、築地でお寿司食べたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, but I really want to eat sushi in Tsukiji!
lines.style: Bright, insistent request. Quick pace—he's already thought this through. A child's earnest negotiation, not quite whining. Lean forward on 'sushi'.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが吉祥寺の井の頭公園に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to Inokashira Park in Kichijoji.
lines.style: Similar warmth as before. Sharing plans. A beat of pause between the place names—letting each destination land. Patient rhythm, like she enjoys watching him process.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、バルサの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, but I want to watch a Barça match!
lines.style: Higher pitch on the opening. Real longing here—not petulant, but genuinely yearning for something specific. Softer than the first request, less insistent. A small hope in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヘッジファンドのお仕事のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me all about his work with hedge funds.
lines.style: Warm but slightly amused—she's sharing something adult that he might not fully grasp. Calm, almost lilting rhythm. The fondness of an older sister sharing family moments.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとスピリチュアルなお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me about something spiritual!
lines.style: Excited, eager to share. Quicker pace than before—he's discovered something and wants her to know he heard it too. Bright energy. Almost proud of himself for listening.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、赤ちゃんがおっぱい飲んでる姿は可愛いわね
lines.en: Sho, babies nursing are so precious, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely tender. Slow pace. Dreamy quality—she's moved by something simple and beautiful. A slight trailing-off at the end, like she's lost in the moment. Almost whispered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがハイビジョンTVを買って下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad bought us a new high-definition TV!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick opening attack—he's eager to share good news. Warm excitement, the innocent joy of a child with something new to show. Close and intimate with her.
